name: Form 4 Mathematics: Differentiation
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to differentiate polynomial functions
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to find stationary points and their nature
learningActivities: Demonstration: teacher differentiates y = 3x^2 + 2x using the power rule
Guided practice: learners differentiate various polynomials
Application: learners find stationary points and their nature
keyPoints: The derivative of x^n is nx^(n-1)
The derivative of a constant is zero
commonMisconceptions: Forgetting to reduce the power by one
lessonEvaluation: Learners differentiate five functions and find one stationary point. Teacher marks and gives feedback.
teacherReflection: Good progress. Emphasise the second derivative test next lesson.
